title: UNHCR Internship Programme
description: A paid internship with the UN High Commissioner for Refugees, most commonly at UNHCR headquarters in Geneva, Switzerland, though placements are also offered at UNHCR's Global Service Centers in Budapest and Copenhagen, the regional office in Amman, and various country/field offices worldwide -- this listing uses Geneva, the headquarters location, as a representative destination. Interns support UNHCR's protection, program, and administrative work in the humanitarian sector. The internship runs 2-6 months, extendable up to a total of 12 months. Interns receive return travel costs plus a partial monthly stipend (estimated at roughly USD 700-1,000 depending on the duty station's cost of living) to help cover housing, transport, and daily living costs. Open worldwide with no nationality restriction, to current students who have completed at least two years of undergraduate study, or recent graduates (within one year of graduation) in a field relevant to UNHCR's work. Applications are accepted year-round rather than against one fixed annual deadline; specific individual internship postings each carry their own closing date.
visaNote: This is an internship, not employment; non-Swiss interns should confirm Switzerland's short-stay/internship entry requirements well ahead of the start date (requirements differ for placements at other duty stations).
